mapper.select: SELECT c.tenant_id AS tenantId, c.result_id AS resultId FROM join_task_cleanup c WHERE c.status IN (1,2,3,4,5,6) AND c.next_execute_at <= #{now} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM join_task_cleanup active WHERE active.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND active.active_group_jid=c.group_jid AND active.result_id <> c.result_id) ORDER BY c.next_execute_at,c.result_id LIMIT 20
SELECT * FROM join_task_cleanup WHERE result_id=#{resultId} FOR UPDATE
